pronunciation.text: Ay bi-at-taʾkīdi aqallu min juzʾin min miʾatayn wa-arbaʿīna, wa-rubbamā aqallu min juzʾin min arbaʿati ālāfin wa-thamāni miʾatin, mimmā yastaṭīʿūna intājahu al-āna bi-faḍli at-taqsīmi wa-at-tansīqi al-munāsibayni li-ʿamaliyyātihimu al-mukhtalifati.

note.ja: 末尾の al-mukhtalifati は、そこで区切る場合 al-mukhtalifah と読みます。
note.en: At a pause here, final al-mukhtalifati is pronounced al-mukhtalifah.

note.en: 不到 is spoken as bú dào. The final 一 in the fractions remains yī.
